tagline: Together with their families, Tinotenda and Dennis invite you to celebrate their marriage
story: Some love stories are loud; ours grew quietly, one conversation at a time, until it became the steadiest thing in both our lives. On the 20th of December we make it official, and we would be honoured to have you there with us.
